meta.name: alfworld-receptacle-finder
meta.description: Searches for a suitable empty or appropriately occupied receptacle (like a shelf or table) to place an object. Use when you are holding an object that needs to be stored or placed and must find a receptacle that meets the placement criteria. Examines candidate receptacles by navigating to and inspecting each one until a suitable location is found.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为手中物品找到合适的放置位置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在虚拟环境中需要为物品寻找合适的架子或桌子。
copy.tagline_en: Find a suitable place to put an object you are holding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find a shelf or table to store an object in a virtual environment.

howto.what: 当你拿着物体需要存放时，Claude 会自动寻找空的或合适的容器（如架子、桌子），依次检查每个容器直到找到合适位置，并执行放置动作。
howto.when: 当你手里拿着物体，需要找一个地方放好时触发。

say.text: 帮我把肥皂放到空架子上。
say.note: Claude 会搜索空架子并放置肥皂。

say.text: 找个空桌子放这个杯子。
say.note: Claude 会检查各个桌子直到找到空的。

howto.what_en: When you are holding an object that needs to be placed, Claude will automatically search for a suitable empty or appropriately occupied receptacle (e.g., shelf, table) by navigating to and inspecting each candidate until a suitable location is found, then perform the placement action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are holding an object that needs to be stored or placed and must find a receptacle meeting placement criteria.

say_en.text: Please put the soapbar on an empty shelf.
say_en.note: Claude will search for an empty shelf and place the soapbar.

say_en.text: Find an empty table to put this cup.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect tables until finding an empty one.
